'''Suilin Escanda''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|355}}.

==History==
Her name indicates that she was almost certainly from [[Tear]].

Suilin held the position for forty-one years until her resignation in {{Ne|396}}. She was [[Aliane Senican]]'s successor and [[Nirelle Coidevwin]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Suilin was an Amyrlin of moderate strength who involved the [[White Tower|Tower]] in a number of foreign intrigues.

One or another faction in the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] was always trying to thwart her, but she successfully outmanoeuvred them until [[396 NE]].

It was put about as voluntary, as was her retirement to the country, but she spent the next twenty-six years under constant guard until her death in {{ne|422}}.

Her body was returned to [[Tar Valon]] and buried with considerable pomp and honour, though.
